audit.summary: Theorem4.2 and its proof evaluate the activation Jacobian at x instead of Wx. An admissible ReLU counterexample has a surjective LoRA differential despite the printed singularity assumption, invalidating a central nonlinear-expressivity comparison. Corrected theorem proved; linear bound and reported empirical outcomes not refuted. Two local release defects affect the GLUE reproduction protocol and the requested LLaMA checkpointing flag.
